קסם KTF י(4D) MSCI World מנוטרלת דולר

legal_form: קרן פתוחה, קרן מחקה (open tracking fund under the Joint Investment Trust Law 1994; bought and redeemed at the unit price through a distributor, not traded on the exchange, ETF-04); קרן בלתי מוגבלת בניירות ערך חוץ; exposure profile 4D; currency-hedged (the tracking asset is the index without the dollar). Trustee: הרמטיק קרנות לנאמנות (2022) בע"מ. Tracking asset on Maya's fund page: MSCI WORLD INDEX - NTR 100%. Payment policy on Maya: 'לא מתחייבת לחלק תשלומים'. REPLICATION: swap: mainly swaps on the tracking asset, with FX forwards and spot to neutralise the dollar exposure (annual report p. 2, 'הדרך שבה הקרן תנוהל': 'ניהול השקעות הקרן מתאפיין בעיקר בביצוע עסקאות החלף על נכס המעקב וכן עסקאות חוזי אקדמה וספוט לצורך נטרול החשיפה למטבע'). Size used to rank the fund (not a fee input): net assets 204.1 million NIS as of 2026-09-30 (Maya fund page, 'שווי נכסים').

source.title: דוח שנתי 'קסם KTF י(4D)י MSCI World מנוטרלת דולר' (מספר בורסה 5139696), תאריך הדוח 31 בדצמבר 2025, קסם קרנות נאמנות בע"מ (Maya filing 1732864, PDF), עמ' 1 'שכר מנהל הקרן' / 'דמי ניהול קבועים'

fixed_management.notes: Fixed management fee as printed in the report: 0% of average annual net assets. Maya's fund page (https://maya.tase.co.il/he/funds/mutual-funds/5139696, read 2026-10-25) shows the same 'דמי ניהול' 0%. The manager committed to the ISA outline to raise its fees only on 1 January (ETF-16). Main prospectus published on Magna on 2025-08-07, reference 2025-03-058648 (not opened; Magna returns 403 to scripts), as the report states; the prospectus block cites this report.

variable_management.notes: Variable management fee rate as printed: 0.3% a year of net assets. Maya's fund page shows 0.3%. The mechanism works in both directions (ETF-14): the amount actually charged or paid depends on the gap to the tracking asset.

tracking_difference_12m.notes: Not printed as one number. The report's table 'תשואות, סטיות תקן ונתוני השוואה' (p. 8) prints the fund's return against its tracking asset: 01.01.2025-31.12.2025 18.20% against 20.32% (MSCI World, the hedged fund's tracking asset); 06.12.2024-31.12.2024 -2.63% against -2.54%. The difference is not computed here (data-update rule). The ISA directive (ETF-07(e)) makes the manager publish the 12-month tracking difference every pricing day; this report points to the third-party page https://chart.bursagraph.co.il/funds.shtml?m=5 for it. That page (Funds Center by Guideline, run for the managers) states on the page 'אין להפיץ בכל דרך כלשהי ... את הנתונים המוצגים באתר', so its figures are not copied here (same position as CAT-43 for TASE lists); founder decision pending.

median_spread.notes: Not applicable: an open tracking fund is bought and redeemed at the unit price computed from net asset value, with no exchange spread. Load (שיעור הוספה): 0% on Maya's fund page and in the report (p. 1). The distributor may charge its own buy and sell commission (MF-26).

fund_level_withholding_drag.notes: Not collected: the report prints no withholding figure and no computation is made here. The fund takes its exposure mainly through derivatives (see REPLICATION in legal_form), so any dividend-withholding drag sits inside the instrument pricing and is not published as a rate.
